$comment: Figma assets whose code counterpart is NOT a top-level component, so no @figma JSDoc tag can point at them and scripts/check-figma-coverage.mjs would report them forever. Each entry is a deliberate statement that the asset IS mapped, just not the usual way. Keep this small: an entry is an admission that Figma and code model the same thing differently, and the better fix is usually to make them agree. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check. An entry may also carry codeOnly: { "<Figma property>": { "values": [code values Figma does not draw], "reason": "..." } }. The parity gate (scripts/lib/figma-parity.mjs) honours it only for a component with no Code Connect template; a template records codeOnly on its own property in figma/code-connect.json. An entry may carry api: { call, source, options, figmaOnly } when the node draws the result of a call rather than the tagged component (the Toast is one toast() call): the parity gate then compares its properties with the fields of that options interface, read from the source.

overrides.name: CardProgress
overrides.reason: Compound member of Card. It IS a manifest entry, so an @figma tag would stick — but a compound part has no docs page of its own and should not need one. Overriding keeps the link honest without inventing a page.

overrides.name: CardMetric
overrides.reason: Compound member of Card. Same shape as CardProgress above.

overrides.name: TabTrigger
overrides.reason: Figma calls it TabTrigger, code calls it TabsTrigger — one letter apart, which is why no name match found it. It is a part of Tabs and has no docs page of its own, so it takes an override rather than a tag. Worth renaming one side to match; until then this records the pairing.

overrides.name: MenuItem
overrides.reason: Compound member of Menu (Radix DropdownMenu). Not exported on its own, so no JSDoc block can carry an @figma tag for it.

overrides.name: BreadcrumbItem
overrides.reason: Compound member. breadcrumb.tsx exports only Breadcrumb and crumbLabelVariants; the item is reached through the compound namespace.

overrides.name: PageButton
overrides.reason: Internal to Pagination — pagination.tsx exports only paginationRange and Pagination. Figma models the individual page button as a component because it needs the variants; code renders it inline.

overrides.name: TimelineItem
overrides.reason: A slot of Timeline (figma/disposition.json), so it takes an override rather than a tag. The Timeline component 2201:133 is built from its instances, and the item needs its own set for the tone and detail variants (redrawn from the hds#637 staging draft as 2252:127, replacing 2201:132).

overrides.name: NavListItem
overrides.reason: A compound part of NavList, mapped by override as TimelineItem is. The NavList component 2209:26 is built from its instances, and the item needs its own set for the Current and State variants.

overrides.name: SheetTrigger
overrides.reason: Compound member of Sheet (the element that opens the sheet). Code attaches the Radix Dialog part directly (Sheet.Trigger is a Radix Dialog part), so no JSDoc block can carry an @figma tag for it. The library draws it as a small component on the Sheet page next to the Sheet set 2265:119.

overrides.name: SheetTitle
overrides.reason: Compound member of Sheet (the heading that names the sheet). Code attaches the Radix Dialog part directly (Sheet.Title is a Radix Dialog part), so no JSDoc block can carry an @figma tag for it. The library draws it as a small component on the Sheet page next to the Sheet set 2265:119.

overrides.name: SheetDescription
overrides.reason: Compound member of Sheet (the supporting text). Code attaches the Radix Dialog part directly (Sheet.Description is a Radix Dialog part), so no JSDoc block can carry an @figma tag for it. The library draws it as a small component on the Sheet page next to the Sheet set 2265:119.

overrides.name: SheetClose
overrides.reason: Compound member of Sheet (the built-in close X). Code attaches the Radix Dialog part directly (Sheet.Close is a Radix Dialog part), so no JSDoc block can carry an @figma tag for it. The library draws it as a small component on the Sheet page next to the Sheet set 2265:119.

overrides.name: IconButton
overrides.reason: In code IconButton is <Button iconOnly>, one component; Figma draws it as its own set (owner decision 2026-11-05, hds#1147). check-figma-components holds the parity contract for it (figma/contracts/IconButton.json).

overrides.name: FormField (form.tsx)
overrides.reason: The Figma set on the Form page is FormField of form.tsx (Label, Helper, State, Required). Until 2026-11-15 the Field tag named it by mistake; Field is 2337:23270. form.tsx gives FormField no JSDoc block of its own to carry a tag (its file tag belongs to Form), so the pairing is recorded here. The Figma name should become FormField (hds#1565).

overrides.name: Form
overrides.reason: figma/inventory.json still lists 85:94 as the Form component. The parity read of 2026-11-15 shows it is now an example frame ("_Form (now an example frame)"), and Form is a layout primitive (figma/disposition.json), so it carries no @figma tag. Remove this entry when the inventory is re-read and no longer lists 85:94 (hds#1573).

overrides.name: Toast
overrides.reason: The Figma Toast is one toast: what toast(options) from useToast() puts on screen. The @figma tag sits on ToastProvider, which owns the viewport, so the parity gate compares the Toast's properties with ToastOptions, read from the source. This is the permanent pairing, not a workaround: it settles hds#1565 F9.

figmaOnly.Dismiss: Rest, Hover and Focus preview the close button's states. The close button is always drawn and its state is runtime, not an option of toast().

overrides.name: ListItem
overrides.reason: A slot of List (figma/disposition.json), mapped by override as TimelineItem is. The List component 2683:2224 is built from ListGroup, which is built from its instances; the item needs its own set for the Trailing and State variants (parity read 2026-11-15).

overrides.name: ListGroup
overrides.reason: A slot of List (figma/disposition.json), mapped by override as ListItem is. Figma redrew it on 2026-11-16 as one component (title, count and action toggles); the Variant and Divider variants moved to the List set.

overrides.name: Stack
overrides.reason: Stack is a layout primitive (figma/disposition.json: in Figma this is auto-layout), so it carries no @figma tag. The library still draws a Stack set to show Direction and Gap (parity read 2026-11-15). Recorded so the parity gate compares its options with the gap prop.

Gap.reason: The primitive space steps (gap='px8') are a code escape hatch for one-off spacing. Figma spacing is auto-layout, so the Gap property draws only the named gaps; a px step in Figma is a number on the frame, not an option.

overrides.name: SegmentedControl/Segment
overrides.reason: Internal to SegmentedControl: code renders each segment inline from the options array. Figma models the segment as a component because it needs the Active, State and Size variants (parity read 2026-11-15).

overrides.name: Table/HeaderCell
overrides.reason: Internal to Table: code renders a header cell for each column of the columns array. Figma models it as a component for the Align, Sort and Density variants (parity read 2026-11-15).

overrides.name: Table/Cell
overrides.reason: Internal to Table: code renders a cell for each row and column. Figma models it as a component for the Slot, Align and Density variants (parity read 2026-11-15).
